prompt: Which site is ready to host a route session this week without arranging a different place for storage?
promptZh: 本週哪個場地不用另安排收納地點，就能舉辦路線圖體驗？

options.text: Birch Hall, using its display case and the kit stand
options.zh: 樺樹館，使用展示櫃和套件支架
options.whyZh: 展示櫃可上鎖，但只能垂直吊掛，不能平放地圖；支架不能解決收納需求。

options.text: Cedar Library, using the kit stand and its reserved drawer
options.zh: 雪松圖書館，使用套件支架及預留的抽屜
options.whyZh: 指南允許使用便攜支架，雪松有可設立支架的空間，以及場次結束後就能使用的可上鎖平放抽屜。

options.text: Elm Center, using its fixed mount and map drawer
options.zh: 榆樹中心，使用固定支架及地圖抽屜
options.whyZh: 抽屜符合規格卻要下週才空出，本週活動用不到。

options.text: Fir Annex, using the kit stand on its countertop
options.zh: 冷杉分館，把便攜支架放在檯面上使用
options.whyZh: 抽屜符合規格，但沒固定支架，也沒有地面空間可放便攜支架；有檯面不等於能架設便攜支架。

explanationZh: 指南允許使用便攜支架，雪松有可設立支架的空間，以及場次結束後就能使用的可上鎖平放抽屜。

vocabulary.note: 有固定支架可不用便攜式落地架，但地圖的平放上鎖收納規定仍適用。

evidence: The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not. / Birch Hall: Fixed mount and deep display case on site. The case locks, but everything inside it hangs vertically. The stand from the kit will fit. / Cedar Library: No fixed mount. Confirmed space on the floor for the kit stand. A flat, lockable map drawer is reserved from the end of every session through the next morning. / Elm Center: Fixed mount and a lockable flat drawer. The drawer is occupied until the following week. The first event at this center is planned for this week. / Fir Annex: A flat, lockable drawer is available, but its fixed mount has been removed. A countertop is available; there is no clear floor space for the stand.

Fir Annex: A flat, lockable drawer is available, but its fixed mount has been removed. A countertop is available; there is no clear floor space for the stand.
